functions.name: inline
functions.spark_sql:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT id, CASE id % 6
        WHEN 0 THEN CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<STRUCT<x: BIGINT, y: STRING>>)
        WHEN 1 THEN CAST(ARRAY() AS ARRAY<STRUCT<x: BIGINT, y: STRING>>)
        WHEN 2 THEN ARRAY(CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<x: BIGINT, y: STRING>))
        WHEN 3 THEN ARRAY(NAMED_STRUCT('x', CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), 'y', 'one'))
        ELSE ARRAY(
            NAMED_STRUCT('x', id, 'y', CAST(NULL AS STRING)),
            NAMED_STRUCT('x', id + 1, 'y', 'two')
        )
    END AS records
    FROM bench WHERE id < 24
)
SELECT id, INLINE(records) AS (x, y) FROM input
